narrative: An unauthenticated registry deserialization RCE on the ML plumbing is exactly the model-supply-chain pressure that pushes hardware-rooted attestation from a developer-preview flag toward a contract-grade requirement. AMD's Advancing AI 2026 (July 22-23) and Black Hat USA (August 1-6) are venues where confidential-GPU attestation and TEE-I/O capabilities get disclosed and productized, reinforcing the timing for this thesis.
remaining_gap: No cloud-AI agreement names confidential-GPU attestation as a procurement clause today; only threat rationale and venue cadence are present, not a contracted term.
